title: Extend a minor by the full identity block
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let n,p,t,s be natural numbers, let P be an n-by-p matrix over R, and let rows:Fin s ↪ Fin n and cols:Fin s ↪ Fin p be embeddings. Set E=diag(P,I_t), with row indices Fin n ⊕ Fin t and column indices Fin p ⊕ Fin t. There exist embeddings rows':Fin(s+t) ↪ (Fin n ⊕ Fin t) and cols':Fin(s+t) ↪ (Fin p ⊕ Fin t) such that det(E[rows',cols'])=det(P[rows,cols]). Empty determinants are 1; no positivity or nontriviality assumptions are imposed.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p t s : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (rows : Fin s ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin s ↪ Fin p), ∃ (rows' : Fin (s + t) ↪ (Fin n ⊕ Fin t)) (cols' : Fin (s + t) ↪ (Fin p ⊕ Fin t)), Matrix.det ((Matrix.fromBlocks P 0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin t) R)).submatrix rows' cols') = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)
